review_scope: Supplementary static wrapper, source-accessor, private preparation-facts provenance and lifecycle-fixture-source review; not the independent whole-eight-file probe/capture security review
observations: Manifest and all eight source SHA256 values independently matched; substantive supplementary review focuses on codex_qualification_windows.go and its tests.
Full pure launch gate precedes one-shot consumption and preparation. Invalid canonical epoch, prompt, callbacks and execution-input failures cannot start qualification through this wrapper.

Production constructor installs private prepareLaunch=q.ensureLaunch and delegateStart=q.rpc.Start. Hooks and concrete wrapper/handle types are unexported; exported options provide no fake provider, JSON PASS, environment authority or handle-import path.

Source accessor checks private wrapper/RPC/qualifier pointer association, boot, pinned identity shapes and exact synthetic S/helper relationship. It returns a copied scope string only; no filesystem, process, qualification or state-consumption action.

Preparation facts require terminal private handle, error, recognized reason, no delegate attempt, original task/run/epoch/source binding, template/boot, and NativeHash/HelperHash/SyntheticSource equality with private configuration. Facts are copied values. Expected pinned hashes do not claim executable bytes were observed at a preflight failure.

Known no-child is explicit and distinct from PID zero. After qualification may have launched, facts require nonzero qualification PID plus Job zero, streams drained and cleanup complete. Qualification identity is never fabricated as model identity.

prepCtx.Err is captured before prepCancel. Apparent successful preparation after deadline/cancellation becomes failure before delegation. Residual overall budget replaces delegated Timeout; delegateAttempted is set before delegate Start, including errors.

Cancellation reaches preparation context and, after publication or publication race, the owned delegate. Delegated Wait uses background context so wrapper completion follows delegate terminal cleanup rather than caller cancellation alone.
Ensure consumes the observation on its first attempt before identity validation, preventing retry after a mismatch. Existing policy/source/boot/process/template/file-identity fences remain.

Source fixtures exercise Start-to-private-prepare-to-delegate flow, remaining budget, preparation cancellation, apparent success after deadline, delegate Start error, delegate cancellation forwarding, copied-JSON foreign-handle rejection and mutated provenance rejection.
coverage_limits: No Go test, compile, Native CLI, App, model, or probe executed by this reviewer. Root first supervised Go run was reported running; outcome is not incorporated.

Deadline fixture uses a 30ms total timeout, so preparation and overall deadlines coincide. The independent 60-second preparation versus longer overall-budget boundary is supported by source inspection, not isolated by that fixture.
Lifecycle fakes replace preparation and RPC start with private in-process functions. They do not establish actual Windows Job, pipe drain, Native sandbox enforcement, or model behavior.
This report does not independently approve the probe/helper/capture implementation, CP674 Host/domain wiring, general-project qualification, or release acceptance.
